caption: Positions 1, 2 and 4 hold check bits; the rest hold data. The last row has position 5 flipped, and the syndrome 101 points to that position.

spec.title: Hamming(7,4) for data 1011, then bit 5 flips
spec.aria: Seven numbered positions with three check bits and four data bits, and a received codeword where the shaded position 5 has flipped.
